# Seriya (English product site)

> Seriya is an open-source, local-first desktop AI agent. It embeds llama.cpp for GGUF models on your machine, exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, and ships under AGPL-3.0 for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

The Chinese product name on this domain is 知远 (ZhiYuan). English marketing and documentation use Seriya.

## Product

- Home (EN): https://www.rongxzyai.com/en/

- Enterprise (EN): https://www.rongxzyai.com/en/enterprise/
- Roadmap (EN): https://www.rongxzyai.com/en/roadmap/
